title: Mixing: Meat City by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The fourth of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 24 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. On this day the song ‘Meat City’ was worked on, although further mixing sessions for it took place on 31 August and 7 and 9 September.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
